visible: Header: "Files" in semibold, and the folder name, samples, on the right in dim
Folders first (.github, config, data, deep, docs, img, media, scripts, src), each with a chevron and a folder icon in the accent color; .github has the git folder icon
Then the files, each icon in the color rows lists: .env.example and cert.pem a key in the theme's ansi3, Makefile and .gitignore a cog, package-lock.json a lock in dim, NOTES a plain file
a name with spaces.txt and it's $(x).txt shown whole, not cut at a space or a quote

manual.do: Click deep, then er, then still
manual.expect: Each folder opens below itself, indented 18px a level, its chevron turned down and its icon an open folder; here.txt shows at the bottom
deep, er and still all open at once
still closes; deep and er stay open

manual.do: Right-click any row, then Collapse all

manual.expect: A 220px menu where the click was: New file…, New folder…; Open in editor, Open with default app, Reveal in Finder (Show in Explorer on Windows, Open containing folder on Linux), Open in terminal; Cut, Copy, Duplicate, Paste (dim); Copy name, Copy path, Copy relative path; Rename…, Move to Trash (Move to Recycle Bin), Delete…; Collapse all (dim when no folder is open). ↑ ↓ move the highlight over the rows that can run, ↑ first landing on the last of them, Enter runs it, Esc closes
The same menu without Open with default app, and with Expand all before Collapse all

manual.do: Copy name, then Copy path, then Copy relative path on src/app.js
manual.expect: A toast for each: app.js, the full path, then src/app.js (from the panel's folder: the scratch copy is outside git)

manual.do: Right-click a name with spaces.txt, Duplicate
manual.expect: a name with spaces copy.txt appears; a second Duplicate makes a name with spaces copy 2.txt

manual.do: Right-click it's $(x).txt, Rename…, type it's $(y).txt, Enter
manual.expect: The row is renamed, nothing else changes; renaming it to an existing name says "<name> already exists here" under the field

manual.do: Right-click README.md, New file…, type README.md
manual.expect: "README.md already exists here" under the field; a name with a / says "A name can't contain /"
app.js moves into docs, which opens to show it; Paste is dim again
A box asks "Delete <name>?" and says it is deleted for good; Enter deletes, Esc cancels

manual.do: Right-click the other duplicate, Move to Trash
manual.expect: The row goes, a toast says so, and the file is in the Trash (the Recycle Bin on Windows)
It opens in a preview tab; the tree still shows samples. Click it again: the same preview tab gets the focus, no new one

manual.do: Right-click docs, New file…, type readme.md, Enter; then Copy the top-level README.md, right-click docs, Paste
manual.expect: docs gets README copy.md on macOS and Windows (README.md there on Linux); docs/readme.md is still the empty file, nothing is replaced

manual.do: Right-click a file, move the highlight to Delete… with ↓, then press and hold Enter
manual.expect: The Delete box opens and stays open while Enter is held; nothing is deleted until a second press
